Method of Attack: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing execution of arbitrary code by tricking authenticated administrators into clicking malicious links
Authentication bypass using default credentials when Magento database connection fails, exploitable via denial-of-service (DoS) attack on database connections
Discoverer: Enguerran Gillier of the Tenable Web Application Security Team
Impacted Systems: Magento online stores using Magmi plugin
Attack Vector: CSRF attack via malicious links targeting authenticated administrators
Denial-of-service attack on Magento database connections to trigger authentication bypass
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept code published on Tenable’s public GitHub page
Exploitation by Magecart Group planting malicious JavaScript stealing credit card data at checkout
